events.title: 1000 Mile BikeWalk for Prevention
events.description: The 1000 Mile BikeWalk for Prevention — Halloween Edition — launches on Halloween morning — October 31, 2026 at Morristown Landing. Check-in and new registrations open at 8:00 am, with the first events starting at 9:00 am. Costumes and bike decorations are highly encouraged. Teams, too. Family-friendly pricing applies. The " Spooktacular " 1000 Miler is a regional fun ride/walk/run for kids, teens, adults... the whole family... to enjoy a fun and healthy morning while helping a good cause. I Not a timed race, the travel distance reported by every participant will be accumulated toward the event goal of 1000 miles. The Central Course is a spectator-friendly one-mile per lap loop on closed roads, offering walkers, runners and rider healthy fun for families and kids. Three laps = 5K. Start -
